def process_graph(graph_data):
    graph_copy = copy.deepcopy(graph_data)
    new_switch_name = 'new_EK_PACKET_SWITCH_80'
    graph_copy.add_node(new_switch_name, name=new_switch_name, type=['EK_PACKET_SWITCH'])
    port_name = f"{new_switch_name}.p1"
    graph_copy.add_node(port_name, name=port_name, type=['EK_PORT'], physical_capacity_bps=1000)
    graph_copy.add_edge(new_switch_name, port_name, type='RK_CONTAINS')
    graph_copy.add_edge('ju1.a1.m2', new_switch_name, type='RK_CONTAINS')
    count = 0
    target = 'ju1.a1.m2'
    for child in graph_copy.successors(target):
        node_data = graph_copy.nodes[child]
        node_types = node_data.get('type', [])
        if 'EK_PACKET_SWITCH' in node_types:
            count += 1
    safety_graph = copy.deepcopy(graph_data)
    return {
        'type': 'text',
        'data': str(count),
        'updated_graph': nx.readwrite.json_graph.node_link_data(safety_graph)
    }
